unit: Add unmapped_facts_json Column / Decide (read before mutate)
description: The column-adding migration reads Matters!N1:N1000 first and refuses to write unless every cell in column N is blank.
why_it_exists: A PUT to Matters!N1 would overwrite whatever header already sits there and orphan the data underneath it. The migration therefore proves the column is unused across the full 1000-row range before writing one cell (added 2026-08-21).

expect.refusal: Column N is not empty. Refusing to write. Found: ["some_other_header","value-1","value-2"]

assertions: safe_to_write is true only when the count of non-blank cells in N1:N1000 is exactly zero.
Cells are trimmed before the emptiness test, so a cell holding only spaces counts as non-empty.
The refusal names at most the first five offending values, so the refusal message cannot itself leak a column of client data.
On the refusal branch no PUT is issued to Matters!N1.
target_unresolved_reason: Administrative / QA-infrastructure workflow. No WF1-WF5/WF9 Code node implements it.
